info.title: excelreader
info.description: Command-line workbook inspection and CSV conversion, built on ExcelReader.NET.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Writes a sheet out to another spreadsheet format, to a file or to standard output.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: Sheet to convert, by name or zero-based index. Defaults to the first. [Default: null]

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write to. Writes to standard output when omitted. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: xlsx, xlsb, xls or csv. Defaults to --output's extension, or csv when writing to standard output. [Default: null]

options.name: --delimiter
options.description: CSV field separator. Ignored for every other format. Defaults to a comma. [Default: null]

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Prints the inferred column schema, as "index[TAB]name[TAB]type", with a trailing ? for nullable columns.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: Sheet to inspect, by name or zero-based index. Defaults to the first. [Default: null]

options.name: --header-row
options.description: 1-based row to take column names from; 0 means the sheet has no header. [Default: 1]

options.name: --sample-size
options.description: How many rows after the header to sample. [Default: 100]

commands.name: sheets
commands.description: Lists every sheet in a workbook, as "index[TAB]name".
